hooks.command: f=$(php -r '$j=json_decode(stream_get_contents(STDIN),true); echo $j["tool_input"]["file_path"] ?? "";'); case "$f" in *.php) vendor/bin/pint "$f" 2>&1 || true ;; esac

f=$(php -r '$j=json_decode(stream_get_contents(STDIN),true); echo str_replace("\\", "/", $j["tool_input"]["file_path"] ?? "");'); case "$f" in */db/schema.sql|*/db/migrations/*) echo 'Reminder: re-apply this migration to a scratch database and confirm it runs clean before committing.' ;; esac
